**STEP 1 - Scene:** An airline-style meal tray photographed from the front and slightly above. It holds a plated main (maki sushi, a ham-and-cheese sandwich, a cookie), a bowl of soup, a bowl of fruit, two small sauce cups, and a glass of water. A colour calibration card and a "3091" label sit in the frame.
